playbookOutputs: Comprehensive Provisional Tax (IRP6) Calculation & Taxable Income Estimate reconciled to your bank statements and management accounts
Tax Liability Summary, Basic Amount vs Actual Estimate Comparison (Paragraph 19 & 20 of the Fourth Schedule penalty check), and SARS Payment Instructions
playbookCommonFailures: Bank statements or management accounts do not cover the full 6-month (1st period) or 12-month (2nd period) tax year-to-date
Underestimation penalty risk on 2nd Provisional Tax (IRP6-02) where taxable income is <= R1m (must be at least 90% of actual or basic amount) or > R1m (must be at least 80% of actual)
Prior 1st period IRP6 payment or year-to-date PAYE withheld is omitted from the tax credit calculation

informationToProvide.label: Company / Taxpayer Name, SARS Tax Number & Provisional Period (e.g., 2026-01 or 2026-02)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the company or individual taxpayer name, 10-digit SARS Income Tax number, whether SBC (s12E) rates apply, and the provisional tax period (1st or 2nd period).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Taxpayer name, 10-digit SARS Income Tax number, entity type (Company/SBC/Individual), and IRP6 period (YYYY-01 or YYYY-02).

informationToProvide.label: Bank Statements for the Relevant Provisional Tax Period (PDF / CSV)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload year-to-date bank statements for the provisional tax period.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Year-to-date bank statements for the provisional tax period.

informationToProvide.label: Management Accounts or Income & Expense Summary for the Period
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload year-to-date management accounts, trial balance, or income/expense schedule.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Year-to-date management accounts or income/expense schedule for the provisional tax period.

informationToProvide.label: Latest ITA34 Assessment & Proof of 1st Period IRP6 / PAYE Credits (if applicable)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your latest ITA34 (for the SARS Basic Amount) and proof of any 1st period provisional tax or PAYE paid.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Latest ITA34 assessment and proof of prior provisional tax or PAYE payments.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect bank statements, management accounts, prior ITA34 and eFiling access
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Taxpayer details, period (YYYY-01 or YYYY-02), bank statements / management accounts, and eFiling access are on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Confirm whether this is a 1st period (6 months) or 2nd period (12 months) provisional tax calculation and ensure all year-to-date records are uploaded.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify SARS Basic Amount, prior IRP6/PAYE credits and completeness of records
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: SARS Basic Amount on the issued IRP6, prior payments, and year-to-date bank/management figures verified
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the issued IRP6 on eFiling (or latest ITA34) to confirm the SARS Basic Amount and any 1st period payment on the ITSA Statement of Account.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Calculate annualized estimated taxable income and IRP6 provisional tax liability
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Provisional tax computation completed (comparing Basic Amount safe harbour vs Actual Estimated Taxable Income under Fourth Schedule para 19/20)
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Compute estimated full-year turnover, deductible expenditure, taxable income, and gross tax (27% corporate / s12E SBC / individual brackets less rebates/credits).Deduct PAYE and 1st period provisional tax paid.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft Provisional Tax Calculation Schedule & Payment Summary
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Provisional Tax working paper and client summary approved by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Draft a clear Provisional Tax Calculation Schedule showing Estimated Turnover, Estimated Taxable Income, Tax Liability, Less Credits, Net IRP6 Payable, and Fourth Schedule penalty guidance.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver Provisional Tax Calculation & Payment Instructions to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Provisional Tax Calculation schedule and payment instructions posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Deliver the Provisional Tax Calculation working paper and payment deadline instructions in Communication History.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the Provisional Tax Calculation order is complete
